name: TRELLEBORG B (FRIA) SK 25
summary: Trelleborg AB is a global engineering group focused on polymer technology, developing engineered solutions that seal, damp, and protect critical applications in demanding industrial environments. Their products and services include sealing solutions, antivibration solutions, and protective equipment, serving various industries such as aerospace, automotive, healthcare, and oil & gas. The company is headquartered in Trelleborg, Sweden.
